app.name: Alufot
app.tagline: Predict every Champions League match. Outscore your friends.

landing.heading: Call the upsets. Take the points.
landing.subheading: A prediction game for you and your friends. Call every scoreline and watch the table move as the goals go in.

blind.title: Blind until kickoff
blind.body: Nobody sees anyone else's pick until the match locks. Enforced in the database, not just hidden in the interface.

live.title: Watch the table move
live.body: Provisional points and live rank changes update as the match plays out, so you know exactly what is riding on the last ten minutes.

scoring.title: Every match has a price
scoring.body: Home, draw and away calls each have their own points for every match. An exact score doubles the listed value.

rules.title: How it works
rules.subtitle: Match calls are simple. Your two season picks add one long-range decision.

exact.title: for the exact score
exact.body: An exact score prediction earns 2× the points listed for the match's actual outcome.

outcome.title: for the correct outcome
outcome.body: Each match lists separate points for a home win, draw and away win. A correct outcome earns the points displayed for that outcome.

rules.nothingElse: There are no jokers or extra multipliers. The only multiplier is 2× for an exact score; champion and top-scorer picks are scored separately after the final.

predict.title: Predict a scoreline, not a winner
predict.body: Set the goals for each side. Which team you are backing follows from the score, so there is nothing else to answer.

season.title: Choose the season winners once
season.body: After signing in, choose the champion and top scorer. Favourites pay fewer points and outsiders pay more. Both choices are final; a shared Golden Boot counts for every joint winner.

lock.title: Locked at kickoff
lock.body: You can change a call as many times as you like until the match starts. After that it is fixed — enforced in the database, not just hidden in the app.

blind.title: Nobody sees your call
blind.body: Other players' predictions stay hidden until the match kicks off. Then everyone's is visible at once.

table.title: Points make the table
table.body: Every settled match and season-pick award add to your total. The global table includes every player in the system, and you can also select a specific friends group.

rules.regulationTime: In the league phase, scoring uses the result after 90 minutes plus stoppage time. In the knockout rounds, scoring also includes extra time, but never the penalty shootout.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.description: Information about Alufot's accessibility, implemented adjustments, and contact options.
accessibility.commitmentBody: We believe everyone should be able to use Alufot equally and comfortably, including people with disabilities, and we work to improve accessibility continuously.
accessibility.standardBody: The site was designed and adapted with the aim of meeting Israel's Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013, and Israeli Standard 5568 Part 1 at level AA, based on the W3C WCAG 2.0 guidelines.

features.keyboard: Links, buttons, forms, and dialogs can be operated with a keyboard and have a visible focus indicator.
features.skipLink: A link at the beginning of every page skips directly to the main content.
features.structure: Pages use headings, navigation regions, and semantic structure to support orientation with assistive technology.
features.forms: Form fields include labels, instructions, and textual status or error messages.
features.images: Informative images have text alternatives; decorative images are hidden from screen readers.
features.zoom: The responsive layout supports browser zoom and does not block pinch-to-zoom on mobile devices.
features.motion: The site respects operating-system preferences for reduced motion and increased contrast.
features.language: The page language and direction are set to Hebrew or English according to the selected locale.

accessibility.menuBody: The persistent accessibility button can enlarge text, enable high contrast, emphasize links, and reduce animation. Preferences are saved on the device for future visits. The menu is an additional aid and is not a substitute for an accessible site.
accessibility.arrangementsBody: Alufot is a digital-only service and does not receive visitors at an office or physical venue. Service and support are provided remotely through the contact details in this statement.
accessibility.limitationsBody: As of this statement's update, we are not aware of a specific accessibility limitation on the site. Some match data and club badges are updated from external sources; team names are also presented as text. If you encounter difficulty, please report it so we can address it.
accessibility.reportBody: If you encounter inaccessible content, a component, or an action, please contact us and include, when possible, the page URL, a description of the issue, the action you attempted, your device and browser, and any assistive technology used.
accessibility.reportDetails: We will review the report and aim to respond within 5 business days.

a11yMenu.description: Adjust the site's display to your needs.

install.title: Install Alufot
